name: HIST 3770
title: History of Pan Africanism
description: (Also offered as AFRA 3224.) The development of ideas of Pan-Africanism, beginning with the proto-Pan-Africanists in the nineteenth century; examination of the linkages between those ideas in Africa and the evolution of Pan-Africanism as a movement in the African Diaspora.
requirement_description: Open to juniors or higher. Recommended preparation: At least one of HIST 3752, 3753, 3563 or 3564.
